sections_en.text: This document sets out the technical inspection checklist for the steam turbine, denoted by the code I1, which is carried out every year, denoted by the code Y1, in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and acquired experience, to provide safety factors for personnel and to maintain safe operation of the equipment.
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority0

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority0
Helmet, shoes and safety belt

sections_en.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out
Cool the unit and stop the slow turning 0

items: Cool the unit and stop the slow turning 0
Inspect turbine bearing HB No. 01
Inspect turbine bearing HB No. 2.
Inspect turbine bearing LP No. 3.
Inspect turbine bearing LP No. 4.
Inspect generator bearings No. 5, 6.
Inspect the generator air coolers and their cleanliness.
Inspect the boiler bypass valve No. A and repair it if necessary.
Clean the condenser cooling box and fit a valve leakage preventer if necessary.
Inspect the condenser cooling pipes and treat leakages.
Inspect the oil vapour extraction fan and repair it if necessary.
Repack the deferred steam valves.
Transfer the oil from the unit tank to the storage tank.
Carry out FLUSHING of the oil lines.
Put the turbine on slow turning

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedure Information System
Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Power Stations | Maintenance Procedures
 | Document No.: ST-001-r0a | Equipment: Steam Turbine Multistage Impulse and Counter pressure GEC Alsthom
Issued to: Damietta Power Station
Document status: Draft No. 1
Document approval date: | Procedure: Annual inspection (I1-Y1)
Next review date:
Introduction
This document sets out the technical inspection checklist for the steam turbine, denoted by the code I1, which is carried out every year, denoted by the code Y1, in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and acquired experience, to provide safety factors for personnel and to maintain safe operation of the equipment.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority0
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority0
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Helmet, shoes and safety belt
Helmet, shoes and safety belt
Work Steps to be Carried Out
Cool the unit and stop the slow turning 0
Inspect turbine bearing HB No. 01
Cool the unit and stop the slow turning 0
Inspect turbine bearing HB No. 01
Inspect turbine bearing HB No. 2.
Inspect turbine bearing LP No. 3.
Inspect turbine bearing LP No. 4.
Inspect generator bearings No. 5, 6.
Inspect the generator air coolers and their cleanliness.
Inspect the boiler bypass valve No. A and repair it if necessary.
Clean the condenser cooling box and fit a valve leakage preventer if necessary.
Inspect the condenser cooling pipes and treat leakages.
Inspect the oil vapour extraction fan and repair it if necessary.
Repack the deferred steam valves.
Transfer the oil from the unit tank to the storage tank.
Carry out FLUSHING of the oil lines.
Put the turbine on slow turning
